claims.hypothesis: Are all three C2H4O2 isomers detected in G31?
claims.experiment: XCLASS LTE fit of unblended transitions in Band 3 survey
claims.result: MF, AA and GA fit with Tex 128-299 K and abundances 5e-9 to 2e-7
claims.finding: All three isomers detected; MF and AA abundances highest in the literature sample

evidence.quote: We have detected for the first time all the 3 isomers of $\mathrm{C_2H_4O_2}$ towards this HMC.

claims.hypothesis: Do the isomers have different emission extents?
claims.experiment: Averaged normalised moment-0 maps and radial profiles
claims.result: MF most extended, AA most compact

evidence.quote: confirming a difference in the extension and showing as AA and GA are more compact than MF

claims.hypothesis: Which formation routes explain the abundances?
claims.result: MF abundance not reproduced by gas-phase only; AA grain-surface route insufficient; GA ambiguous
claims.finding: Grain-surface needed for MF; GA both possible; AA gas-phase needs more testing

evidence.quote: The comparison with chemical models suggests that the MF abundance found in G31 seems not reproducible using only gas-phase routes, thus revealing the need for grain-surface reactions.
